title: Reliability & Debloater Update
headline: Verified tweak recovery, clearer Windows readings, and a smoother Debloater experience.
changes: Saved slider settings are checked against Windows after startup and restored when a saved value has changed, subject to active Premium entitlement.
The Debloater header gives its existing watercolor artwork subtle fluid motion and respects reduced-motion settings.
Windows process counts use a native fallback when the usual telemetry provider returns an invalid zero reading.
